description: This file defines special mathematical functions and their wrappers for tensor operations in PyTorch, including functions like Bessel functions, error functions, and softmax variants, with some registered decompositions and aliases.

methods.name: bessel_j0
methods.description: Computes the Bessel function of the first kind, order zero, for tensor input.

methods.name: bessel_j1
methods.description: Computes the Bessel function of the first kind, order one, for tensor input.

methods.name: entr
methods.description: Computes the entropy function for tensor input, registered as a decomposition of aten.special_entr.

methods.name: erfcx
methods.description: Computes the scaled complementary error function for tensor input, registered as a decomposition of aten.special_erfcx.

methods.name: expit
methods.description: Alias for torch.sigmoid, representing the logistic sigmoid function.

methods.name: i0e
methods.description: Computes the exponentially scaled modified Bessel function of order zero for tensor input.

methods.name: i1
methods.description: Computes the modified Bessel function of order one for tensor input.

methods.name: i1e
methods.description: Computes the exponentially scaled modified Bessel function of order one for tensor input.

methods.name: log_ndtr
methods.description: Computes the logarithm of the normal distribution CDF for tensor input, registered as a decomposition of aten.special_log_ndtr.

methods.name: logit
methods.description: Computes the log-odds (logit) function for tensor input, registered as a decomposition of aten.logit.

methods.name: log_softmax
methods.description: Computes the log softmax of tensor input along a specified dimension.

methods.name: multigammaln
methods.description: Computes the multivariate gamma function for tensor input, registered as a decomposition of aten.mvlgamma.

methods.name: ndtr
methods.description: Computes the normal distribution CDF for tensor input, registered as a decomposition of aten.special_ndtr.

methods.name: ndtri
methods.description: Computes the inverse of the normal distribution CDF for tensor input, registered as a decomposition of prims.ndtri.

methods.name: softmax
methods.description: Computes the softmax of tensor input along a specified dimension.

methods.name: spherical_bessel_j0
methods.description: Computes the spherical Bessel function of order zero for tensor input.

methods.name: xlog1py
methods.description: Computes a tensor equivalent of a * log1p(b) with handling for scalar inputs.

methods.name: zeta
methods.description: Computes the Riemann zeta function for tensor inputs.
